import numpy as np, os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

import numpy as np, os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
I=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); O=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])

def comps_of(A):
    H=len(A); W=len(A[0])
    pts={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if A[r][c]}
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for p in sorted(pts,key=lambda t:(t[0],t[1])):
        if p in seen: continue
        st=[p]; cl=[]
        while st:
            x,y=st.pop()
            if (x,y) in seen: continue
            seen.add((x,y)); cl.append((x,y))
            for dx,dy in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                q=(x+dx,y+dy)
                if q in pts and q not in seen: st.append(q)
        out.append(cl)
